claims.statement: Bluestones were rearranged and the Avenue was built around 2300–2200 BCE. The Y and Z pits date to around 1800–1500 BCE. These were separate episodes, not continuous building work.
The map marks the archaeological site, using the Heritage Gateway reference coordinates.
